entries.goal_pattern: Discover workspace roots and open server artifacts
entries.how_to: Call get_workspace_info; read returned artifact resource URIs through MCP.

entries.goal_pattern: Convert ordinary groups and layers without changing geometry
entries.how_to: Use set_group_mode; create_group(mode/label); rename_object(label=...) keeps ID.

entries.goal_pattern: Preview a detail or compare a fixed region before and after
entries.how_to: render_preview(object_id/region); compare_region(region, snapshot_id).

entries.goal_pattern: Replace one SVG fragment preserving its root ID
entries.how_to: Pass a same-tag fragment; ID/reference checks apply; approval_token required.

entries.goal_pattern: Repeat editable objects along a line or inside an area
entries.how_to: Plan polyline/rectangle, count/spacing, linked/copies and seeded variation.

entries.goal_pattern: Draw a rectangle / square
entries.how_to: Call create_rect with x, y, width, height (and rx/ry for rounded corners).

entries.goal_pattern: Draw a circle
entries.how_to: Call create_circle with cx, cy, r.

entries.goal_pattern: Draw an ellipse / oval
entries.how_to: Call create_ellipse with cx, cy, rx, ry.

entries.goal_pattern: Draw a line
entries.how_to: Call create_line with x1, y1, x2, y2.

entries.goal_pattern: Draw a polygon or polyline
entries.how_to: Call create_polygon (closed) or create_polyline (open) with a list of points.

entries.goal_pattern: Draw an arbitrary path / freeform shape
entries.how_to: Call create_path with an SVG path `d` string.

entries.goal_pattern: Add text / a label
entries.how_to: Call create_text with x, y and the text content.

entries.goal_pattern: Group objects together / make a group
entries.how_to: Use group_objects to wrap existing object ids; create_group makes an empty group.

entries.goal_pattern: Move an object into another group / reparent
entries.how_to: Call reparent_object with preserve_appearance=True for checked preservation.

entries.goal_pattern: Reuse / clone an element via <use>
entries.how_to: Call create_use referencing an existing element id to instance it.

entries.goal_pattern: Add a gradient fill (linear or radial)
entries.how_to: Define one with add_linear_gradient / add_radial_gradient, then set_fill to it.

entries.goal_pattern: Create a brand-new blank document
entries.how_to: Call create_document with width/height/units to start a new SVG in the workspace.

entries.goal_pattern: Replace the whole document SVG or insert an SVG fragment
entries.how_to: Use set_document_svg to replace the doc; insert_svg_fragment to paste a snippet.

entries.goal_pattern: Open an existing SVG file to work on it
entries.how_to: Call open_document with the workspace path to get a doc_id for the other tools.

entries.goal_pattern: Understand a document's structure (tree, layers, styles, fonts, assets)
entries.how_to: Call inspect_document with the doc_id for the full structural picture and ids.

entries.goal_pattern: Find specific objects by color / tag / text / position
entries.how_to: Call find_objects with filters (fill/stroke/tag/text/id_prefix/bbox) for ids.

entries.goal_pattern: Validate that a document is well-formed / correct
entries.how_to: Call validate_document with the doc_id to check well-formedness and report issues.

entries.goal_pattern: Get quality metrics for a document
entries.how_to: Call quality_report with the doc_id for machine-readable quality metrics.

entries.goal_pattern: See what the runtime / server can do (capabilities)
entries.how_to: Call list_capabilities for the runtime matrix (incl. this intents map).

entries.goal_pattern: Change an object's fill color
entries.how_to: Call set_fill with the object id and a paint value (find_objects gets the id).

entries.goal_pattern: Change an object's stroke / outline
entries.how_to: Call set_stroke with the object id and stroke paint/width.

entries.goal_pattern: Change opacity / transparency
entries.how_to: Call set_opacity with the object id and a 0..1 opacity.

entries.goal_pattern: Change the font of text
entries.how_to: Call set_font with the text object id and font-family/size.

entries.goal_pattern: Replace text content
entries.how_to: Call replace_text with the text object id and the new string.

entries.goal_pattern: Replace one color with another across the document
entries.how_to: Call replace_color with the from/to paint values to swap a color document-wide.

entries.goal_pattern: Apply a color palette / theme to the document
entries.how_to: Call apply_palette with a palette mapping to recolor the document to a theme.

entries.goal_pattern: Move / scale / rotate an object
entries.how_to: Use move_object, scale_object, or rotate_object with the id and the transform.

entries.goal_pattern: Duplicate or rename an object
entries.how_to: Use duplicate_object to copy an object; rename_object to change its id.

entries.goal_pattern: Apply several typed edits at once (batch) in one atomic operation
entries.how_to: Call apply_edits with an ordered list of typed `op` edits (one snapshot, atomic).

entries.goal_pattern: Bulk-edit every object matching a selector (recolour all blue rects, etc.)
entries.how_to: Call transform_objects with a find_objects selector + ONE typed op (set_fill / move_object / delete_object / …); dry_run first, then dry_run=false.

entries.goal_pattern: Resize the canvas or fit it to the content
entries.how_to: resize_canvas sets size; fit_to_content crops to art; normalize_viewbox tidies.

entries.goal_pattern: Tile or repeat objects across the canvas
entries.how_to: Call tile to repeat object(s) in a grid across the canvas.

entries.goal_pattern: Simplify / clean up paths
entries.how_to: simplify_path reduces nodes; cleanup_paths tidies data (HIGH risk, dry-run first).

entries.goal_pattern: Combine paths or do boolean union / difference
entries.how_to: combine_paths merges; boolean_union/boolean_difference do shape math (HIGH risk).

entries.goal_pattern: Convert a stroke into a filled path / outline
entries.how_to: Call stroke_to_path to outline strokes into fills (HIGH risk, dry-run first).

entries.goal_pattern: Break a compound path apart
entries.how_to: Call break_apart to split a compound path into separate subpaths (HIGH risk).

entries.goal_pattern: Export a PNG (or other raster/PDF) of the document
entries.how_to: export_document writes a PNG/PDF/etc; render_preview gives a quick preview.

entries.goal_pattern: Export just one object
entries.how_to: Call export_object with the doc_id and object id to export that object alone.

entries.goal_pattern: Export many sizes/formats at once (batch)
entries.how_to: export_batch takes a list of specs; create_icon_set makes a standard icon set.

entries.goal_pattern: Make the SVG smaller / optimized for the web
entries.how_to: Call svg_web_optimize to losslessly shrink the SVG (reversible).

entries.goal_pattern: Export with a web or print profile
entries.how_to: export_web_profile gives web-ready output; export_print_profile prints (CMYK/DPI).

entries.goal_pattern: Save the document to a new file
entries.how_to: Call save_document_as with the doc_id and a new workspace path.

entries.goal_pattern: Snapshot, undo, or restore the document state
entries.how_to: create_snapshot checkpoints; list_snapshots browses; restore_snapshot rolls back.

entries.goal_pattern: Connect to a running Inkscape (live mode) and work on the open canvas
entries.how_to: Connect to an already running window; connecting never launches Inkscape. On managed macOS use live_launch only on an explicit request to open Inkscape, then connect, list and select the task drawing; read its scene, then edit. Reconnect resets the task binding. Inspect IDs with live_inspect_objects for bounded computed styles/resource links. Review live_change_package with dry_run=true; resubmit identical edits and returned guards with explicit per-operation approval to apply through the guarded native helper. GUI Undo/Redo acceptance for packages is pending.

out_of_scope.label: raster/photo pixel editing
out_of_scope.reason: This is a vector/SVG server — it cannot edit raster/photo PIXELS (JPEG/PNG/GIF/bitmap). Use raster images only as visual references; deliberately author vectors. Pixel editing (retouch/filter/crop photo content) is out of scope.

out_of_scope.label: arbitrary Actions / extensions / scripts
out_of_scope.reason: Per ADR-003 there is no raw-action/extension/script escape hatch in the MVP surface. Use the small typed tools instead; raw Inkscape Actions and arbitrary extension/script execution are not exposed.

out_of_scope.label: network / URL fetch
out_of_scope.reason: The server is offline by policy (security sec.12: no network). It cannot fetch an image, font, or any asset from a URL or the internet. Provide local files in the workspace instead.

out_of_scope.label: code execution
out_of_scope.reason: Executing arbitrary code/shell/programs is a restricted risk class and is not exposed (security sec.12: no arbitrary execution). The server only runs its own typed tools.

no_match_note: No confident match. Browse the full goal→tool map via list_capabilities (its `intents` section), or call inspect_document to see a document's structure and addressable ids.
